The Association of Confessional Baptist Churches in the United Kingdom (abbreviated as ACBC UK) is an association of Reformed Baptist churches in the United Kingdom that confess the 1689 Baptist Confession of Faith. The association was formally established by three churches on March 7, 2023 at the inaugural association meeting that took place at Countesthorpe Baptist Church in Leicestershire.
